Hi all — thanks for the sync this morning. Quick write-up of what we covered and the owners we agreed on. Please flag any mistakes.

- SOC 2 evidence: confirmed baseline evidence set (user access lists, change control, incident log extract).
- DPA carveouts: FastPay asked for clarity on subprocessor list and data retention window for logs.
- Audit logs: scope and retention — need export sample and retention policy excerpt.
- Pen test asks: FastPay to share their scope and preferred tester window; Redwood to confirm external network exposure statement.

Action items (owners & target dates):
1) Upload SOC 2 evidence index (csv) and mark verified docs — owner: Marissa Cole — target: 2029-04-18 EOD.
2) Compile subprocessor list + DPA appendix note — owner: Laura Bennett — target: 2029-04-17 noon PT.
3) Provide an audit-log sample export and retention policy snippet — owner: Karthik Iyer — target: 2029-04-18 5pm PT.
4) Confirm pen-test acceptance criteria and external exposure statement; request FastPay to share scope doc — owner: Laura (confirm) / FastPay (scope) — target: 2029-04-19.

Attachments: I'll upload the initial evidence index (s3_evidence_index.csv) to the Drive folder and paste the link below.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDEF-map-evidence
HubSpot: HubSpot deal FP-2029-0415

Next check-in: Thu 04/18 9:00am PT (short 20-min sync).

Thanks,

- Marissa uploaded the SOC 2 evidence index and attached the change-control PDF and role matrix to the Drive folder (see link).
- Karthik uploaded the 7-day audit export and retention-policy excerpt (retention: aggregated logs retained 90 days, raw request logs retained 30 days by default, longer retention available via contract).
- Per DPA appendix: we will include the full subprocessor list and call out log retention defaults (30 days raw, 90 days aggregated) — Laura to share updated appendix by EOD today.
- Pen test timing: Redwood confirms blackout windows and will provide a pre-engagement safety checklist. Laura will confirm Redwood's external exposure statement and coordinate a 15-min safety readout with FastPay week of 2029-05-01.

- Karthik Iyer — upload audit export + retention excerpt — 2029-04-18 15:00 PT — DONE (files uploaded).
- Laura Bennett — DPA appendix (subprocessors + retention note) — 2029-04-18 17:00 PT — IN PROGRESS (will attach to HubSpot).
- Laura Bennett — pre-engagement pen-test safety readout & exposure statement — schedule for week of 2029-05-01 — TODO.

Tom — can you confirm whether the 2029-05-06 to 2029-05-10 window works for FastPay? If yes we'll lock it and send the safety checklist.

Thanks everyone — this should keep us on track for the MAP close timeline next week.
